name: Shapemaster
body:
A shapemaster changes her form as others could change their clothes. Her identity is not defined by the body she inhabits at the moment, but only by her inner flame. Mostly druids (not legendary druids) and shifters (legendary shifters included) choose the shapemaster path, but a few characters from other classes are able to select it too.

Requirements

To qualify to become a shapemaster, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Feats: Alertness, Endurance
Special: Wild shape* or equivalent class feature at druid level 7th.
Features
Class Skills

The shapemaster’s class skills are Acrobatics (Dex), Bluff (Cha), Climb (Str), Craft (Int), Diplomacy (Cha), Disguise (Cha), Handle Animal (Cha), Knowledge (nature) (Int), Perception (Wis), Profession (Wis), Stealth (Dex), Survival (Wis), Swim (Str).

Skill Points at each Level: 4 + Int modifier.

Hit Die: d8

Level	Spells
1st	aberrant form I, beast shape III, fey form I, lesser proxy aspect, monstrous physique I, object form I, vermin shape I, undead anatomy I.
3rd	beast shape IV, monstrous physique II, object form I, ooze form I, vermin shape II, undead anatomy II.
5th	aberrant form II, fey form II, form of the dragon I**, geniekind, monstrous physique III, object form III, ooze form II, proxy aspect, undead anatomy III.
7th	aberrant form III, fey form III, form of the dragon Ii**, giant form I, magical beast shape, monstrous physique IV, ooze form III.
8th	form of the dragon III**, giant form II, greater proxy aspect, iron body, statue, undead anatomy IV.
Table 7: Shapemaster
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special
1st	+1	+2	+2	+0	Improved wild shape, wild feat
2nd	+2	+3	+3	+0	Wild feat
3rd	+3	+3	+3	+1	—
4th	+4	+4	+4	+1	—
5th	+5	+4	+4	+1	Wild feat
6th	+6	+5	+5	+2	—
7th	+7	+5	+5	+2	A thousand faces
8th	+8	+6	+6	+2	Wild feat
9th	+9	+6	+6	+3	Timeless body
10th	+10	+7	+7	+3	No form of my own
Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

Shapemasters gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.

Improved Wild Shape (Sp)

A shapemaster adds her class level to her effective druid level for determining the powers and uses per day of her wild shape ability*. In addition, as she increases in experience, her wild shape can work in new ways. Every time she gains a level in this prestige class, the shapemaster can select one new spell effect from the following list to add to her wild shape ability. The shapemaster can select any effect available to her level in this prestige class or less. The GM can allow other spells to be added to the list.

9th Level– fey form IV.
10th Level– polymorph any object, shapechange.

* The shifter shape ability of a legendary shifter counts as wild shape for the purpose of qualifying for this prestige class.

** With the GM’s permission, these spells can also provide the effect of the corresponding form of the alien dragon or form of the exotic dragon spells.

Wild Feats

At 1st level, 2nd level, and every 3 levels thereafter, a shapemaster gains a bonus feat. This must be a feat that has the wild shape ability as a prerequisite, and the character must meet its other prerequisites.

A Thousand Faces (Ex)

At 7th level, a shapemaster gains the ability to change her appearance at will, as if using the alter self spell, but only while in her normal form.

Timeless Body (Ex)

At 9th level, a shapemaster no longer takes ability score penalties for aging and cannot be magically aged. Any penalties she may have already incurred, however, remain in place. Bonuses still accrue, and the character still dies of old age when her time is up.

No Form of My Own (Su)

At 10th level, the shapemaster reached the pinnacle of her wildshaping abilities. She can use improved wild shape once per round, at will, gains the shapechanger subtype, and becomes immune to any transmutation effect unless she is willing to accept it.
